figures.name: Gwydion

ability.name: Master of Illusion
ability.description: Create a perfect decoy of one ally; enemy attacks the decoy for 1 turn.

figures.description: Wizard-prince of the Mabinogion who weaves reality itself with his magic and raises armies from illusion.

figures.name: Arianrhod

ability.name: Silver Wheel
ability.description: Lock one enemy's fate: their stats cannot change in any direction for 2 turns.

figures.description: Cosmic goddess of the silver wheel of stars who weaves destiny and refuses to be bound by any man.

figures.name: Lleu Llaw Gyffes

ability.name: Radiant Strike
ability.description: Deal 7 light damage; enemy cannot regenerate HP next turn.

figures.description: Solar warrior who cannot be killed except under a unique impossible circumstance — his weakness hidden in paradox.

figures.name: Rhiannon

ability.name: Three Birds of Rhiannon
ability.description: Sing: put all enemies to sleep for 1 turn; wake all sleeping allies.

figures.description: Otherworldly queen on a white horse whose magical birds can revive the dead or kill the living.

figures.name: Ceridwen

ability.name: Awen Cauldron
ability.description: Grant one ally omniscience for 2 turns: they can copy any enemy ability once per turn.

figures.description: Witch goddess who brewed the cauldron of poetic inspiration, accidentally bestowing it on the young Taliesin.

figures.name: Bran the Blessed

ability.name: Cauldron of Rebirth
ability.description: Resurrect one fallen ally at full HP; this card takes 4 damage.

figures.description: Tragic giant king whose severed head remained alive and prophetic; his magical cauldron resurrects the slain.

figures.name: Taliesin

ability.name: Chief of Bards
ability.description: Recite a poem: negate all enemy special abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: Shape-shifting chief bard of Britain who remembers all history from the beginning of the world.

figures.name: Math fab Mathonwy

ability.name: Wind-Catching
ability.description: Trap one enemy in magical stasis for 2 turns; cannot be freed by any means.

figures.description: King-wizard who can only survive if his feet rest in a virgin's lap and whose magic is absolute.

figures.name: Pryderi

ability.name: Lord of Dyfed
ability.description: Absorb 3 damage from any source on behalf of one ally.

figures.description: Firstborn son of Rhiannon whose life from birth to death weaves through all four branches of the Mabinogion.

figures.name: Pwyll

ability.name: Lord of the Otherworld
ability.description: After spending 1 turn in defense, gain +3 power next turn.

figures.description: Prince of Dyfed who spent a year ruling the Otherworld in disguise, gaining wisdom and honor.

figures.name: Branwen

ability.name: White Raven
ability.description: Send a message to one ally in reserve; swap them immediately into play.

figures.description: Daughter of Llyr whose tragic marriage triggered a catastrophic war between Britain and Ireland.

figures.name: Blodeuwedd

ability.name: Flower Face
ability.description: Charm one enemy and redirect their next attack to their strongest ally.

figures.description: Woman created from flowers who betrayed her husband Lleu and was transformed into an owl as punishment.

figures.name: Dylan ail Don

ability.name: Wave-Born
ability.description: Become immune to all non-magic attacks for 1 turn.

figures.description: Son of Arianrhod who slipped into the sea at birth and became master of all ocean waves.

figures.name: Efnisien

ability.name: Act of Ruin
ability.description: Deal 7 damage but also deal 3 damage to one random ally — uncontrollable.

figures.description: Malicious prince whose deliberate cruelty caused catastrophic war but whose final sacrifice saved his people.

figures.name: Annwn Hound

ability.name: Hell Hound Hunt
ability.description: Track one enemy: deal +2 bonus damage to that target for the rest of the battle.

figures.description: White hound with red ears that rides with the Wild Hunt of the Otherworld, baying for chosen souls.

figures.name: Gofannon

ability.name: Smith's Blessing
ability.description: Equip one ally: +2 power; if that ally is destroyed, forge a new weapon for the next.

figures.description: Divine smith of the Welsh gods, uncle of Lleu, whose ale feast grants immortality to the Tuatha.

figures.name: Amaethon

ability.name: Sacred Harvest
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies at the start of each of your turns for 2 turns.

figures.description: Divine farmer of the Welsh gods who stole a white roebuck and hound from the Otherworld.

figures.name: Caswallawn

ability.name: Invisible Cloak
ability.description: This card becomes untargetable for 1 turn; deal 4 damage to one enemy.

figures.description: British warrior king who slew the guardians of the island while hidden under a magic invisibility cloak.

figures.name: Don

ability.name: Divine Mother
ability.description: Reduce the cost of all your card abilities by 1 this turn.

figures.description: Ancient mother goddess of the Welsh divine family from whom Gwydion, Arianrhod and all the sky gods descend.

figures.name: Creiddylad

ability.name: Eternal Spring
ability.description: Remove all winter/cold/dark debuffs from all allies.

figures.description: Eternal flower maiden perpetually contested between Gwythyr and Gwyn ap Nudd until the end of the world.
